findings: Dance figure has paired femurs .420m, tibias .400m, upper arms .285m and forearms .255m, verified from the inverse-kinematics joints. Foot spacing differs while the bone lengths remain equal. Both shoe soles meet y=0.

Upper-arm radius .039m is below thigh radius .071m. Continuous skin/sleeves and trousers cover the joints; palms/thumbs connect to wrists. A short neck overlaps shirt and head, leaving about.042m between shirt top and head bottom. Flat skin paint avoids conflicting limb shadows.

Front, rear, left, right, top and icon projections were checked for arm/torso separation, leg spacing, connected limbs, hair/head fit and grounded shoes. Hair-cap winding was repaired before final review. These are selected geometry checks, not exhaustive collision or choreography validation.

Bookmobile inherits the previously reviewed original coach construction: continuous floor/body, closed sloping cab, four equal-radius tires at matching axle heights, suspension and bumper. All tires meet y=0. Open-book emblems replace clinic graphics and stay on side panels.

Resin pendant, coloring sheet and financial-coaching graphics are direct planar emblems. The pendant is an optical illustration of an embedded flower, not a physical resin simulation. No articulated person is hidden inside these graphics.

references.finding: Official format describes a lower-intensity dance class; a grounded generic pose avoids making jumping universal.
Primary library page confirms mobile library service while Arlington is closed, including an upcoming Bookmobile event.
Manufacturer describes preserving dried flowers in resin jewelry and other molded objects; artwork uses an original floral pendant emblem.
